summary: A JLT clinic with seven named doctors across general, cosmetic and surgical care is a strength, but dead buttons and a typo in the booking button appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: Discover our team, Discover our services and the Book now button under Orbital Decompression Surgery appear to link to #, and the footer logo appears to link to #.
findings.cost: Patients who click to learn or book land nowhere.

findings.problem: The booking button appears to read 'book appoinment', the footer appears to read 'Adress', and the insurance text appears to say 'accepts all major local and international indirect insurance companies'.
findings.cost: Typos on the booking path and in insurance details look careless.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and correct insurance wording.

findings.problem: The top menu appears to show About us twice and Our team twice, and the hero appears to say 8+ doctors while seven appear in the team section.
findings.cost: Duplicate menu items and mixed counts make the site look unfinished.
findings.fix: One clean menu and matching figures.

findings.problem: The booking form appears to show an error message as static text, the time picker appears to stop at 19:00 while the clinic is open until 20:00, and the blog excerpt appears cut off mid sentence.
findings.cost: Visible errors and a cut time picker lose bookings.
findings.fix: A real booking flow with correct time slots.

redesign: A clean menu and a real booking flow.
